damage_story: A localized strike opens the east-southeast palisade and drops part of the livestock-supply canopy, but resident traders continue using the guarded gate, lodge, bunkhouse, well and enclosed paddocks.
damage_zone: east-southeast palisade and southeast market canopy
environment_layer: fallen full-log palisade members and gravel at the perimeter breach
localized blue-wool canopy collapse with rubble below
weathered asphalt approach and gravel internal circulation
intact animal feed, water and daily-service fixtures
occupation_layer: six persistent villagers distributed among trade and lodging functions
one persistent iron golem guarding the north service spine
two cows, two sheep, one pig and one chicken retained in the two paddocks
invariants: north wagon gate and both guard rooms survive
four market approaches and all lodge rooms remain reachable
well, bunkhouse and both paddock gates remain connected
both two-level paddock boundaries remain intact
damage remains localized to the two declared failure zones
